meta.description: Lineup connects Discord servers that recruit staff with people looking for a team.

purpose.default: This page needs a Discord account.
purpose.profile: Edit your public profile, the one servers see when they recruit.
purpose.experiences: Add your experience and have it verified.
purpose.posts: Find your posts: published, draft or closed.
purpose.editor: Write a post for a server or for yourself.
purpose.claim: Claim a server to manage its profile and posts.
purpose.manage: Manage a server's profile, posts and visibility.

sessionError.note: Your session could not be checked.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page left the server, or the address is wrong.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.body: This page could not be displayed. Reload it or go back to the posts.

suspended.title: Your Moddy access is suspended.
suspended.body: You can no longer publish or edit on Lineup. Public pages stay open to read.
suspended.noticeBody: Lineup is read-only for you. You can no longer publish or edit.
